_meta.purpose: Structured facts about Jordanian scam patterns that have been verified against a named source. DARA' compares a fresh analysis against these and, only on a strong match, tells the user the case resembles a documented pattern.
_meta.source_rule: An entry may only be added when it comes from genuine evidence with a named source: an official warning, a documented case, or a real message captured from an official source. Content written for v2, model-generated text, and the synthetic eval cases are NOT evidence and must never appear here.
_meta.status: EMPTY — no verified evidence exists in this repository yet. content/eval-cases.json marks one case as source 'real' (gam_parking_fine) but its text is still REPLACE_WITH_EXACT_SMS_TEXT and reference/gam-fake-fine.png was never added, so nothing can be normalised from it. content/v1-content.json is unverified throughout by its own _meta. Until an entry exists here, matching returns nothing and the app shows no pattern section at all.
_meta.how_to_add: Append to `patterns` using the shape below. `verified` must be true and `source_name` must name the source. Nothing renders until then.

shape.impersonated_entity: the entity the scam claims to be
